messages:
lisa_csm: Morning async — quick standup for CS/Eng handback. What I did: triaged AcmeFin webhook delays and captured affected sessions. Blockers: renewal for AcmeFin on Fri is at risk until latency stabilizes. Today: need eng to review a safe timeout rollback and the CR for the webhook timeout/circuit-breaker. @kevin_eng can you take?

kevin_eng: On it. I saw retries spike around 02:10 UTC — upstream kept returning 504s. Pushed a small config to staging, but want a quick CR before promoting. I'll open a PR in a few.

anya_support: Thanks — I logged affected accounts (AcmeFin, SummitPay) and added notes to their tickets. AcmeFin renewal touchpoint is scheduled for Friday; marking as high priority :exclamation:

sam_ops: FYI I rolled back the prod timeout from 10s->5s earlier to reduce queued requests; after rollback 503s dropped ~40% but latency increased for some large payloads. We can route AcmeFin to dedicated-region as a short-term mitigation if approved. @marta_planning any quick thumbs?

marta_planning: I can approve routing AcmeFin to us-east-dedicated for 24h as a handoff. Kevin, if you can add a canary plan and the CR I'll greenlight. I've asked billing to pause auto-escalation notifications to the contract owner until we confirm stability.

kevin_eng: Opened PR #21512346 — "webhook: increase upstream timeout + circuit-breaker". PTAL @lisa_csm. Test plan in PR: canary on prod-1 (5% traffic) -> monitor 5xx + p95. Quick local repro: 
```bash
curl -v -H 'x-customer: acme' https://staging.redwood/api/v1/webhook -d '{}'
```
I also added a small retry-backoff and a KV cache bypass flag for partner payloads.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: webhook-service:v1.8.2-canary -> prod-1. Status: 3/4 healthy (30s).

lisa_csm: Thanks everyone — I'll update AcmeFin CS lead that we routed them and the canary is in progress. Any residual risk to the renewal if prod regresses? @kevin_eng

kevin_eng: Low risk. We have fallback routing and circuit-breaker thresholds. I'll post SLO graphs and the canary logs in ~30m and update the PR with results.

lisa_csm: Great — please flag in the PR if you want a short rollback window for the renewal call. I'll be on standby for customer comms.
